attributes: Opportunity Type, Opportunity Stage, Opportunity Creator Profile, Opportunity Source Detailed, Opportunity Owner Name
goal: Monitor sales pipeline progression and opportunity creation velocity to track weekly and multi-week sales development performance across different opportunity stages and team members.
user_context: Sales directors and revenue operations leaders use this dashboard during weekly and monthly sales review meetings to track opportunity creation performance across different sales stages (M1, S0, S1), first examining high-level KPI counts and ACV values for current and prior periods, then drilling down into individual contributor performance by analyzing creator names, teams, and opportunity sources to identify top performers and underperformers, comparing team effectiveness across different opportunity types (new customer vs. existing customer expansion), reviewing detailed deal tables to understand specific opportunity characteristics and disqualification patterns, and using stage progression analysis and source attribution data to optimize lead generation strategies and sales process improvements while ensuring they focus on non-closed won opportunities with positive ACV values.
